author: Arthur Conan Doyle
title: Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
edition: Project Gutenberg 48320 transcription of New York: Harper & Brothers text, copyright 1892; printing undated. Prepared from Internet Archive/American Libraries scans. Prose line wrapping normalized; original paragraphs, spelling, punctuation, and underscore emphasis retained. Publisher illustration captions and digitizer matter omitted.

rights.basis: This original English text is identified by the supplied 1892 publisher and copyright leaf. Its US copyright term has expired by 2026; Project Gutenberg explicitly marks this transcription public domain in the USA. No modern introduction, translation, or illustrations are supplied.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 48320 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Kept from "Adventure I" to THE END; removed the PG header and footer, the title-page imprint, copyright leaf, contents and illustrations lists, illustration captions, the publisher's advertisements and the transcriber's note. Lines of each paragraph joined with single spaces (runs of spaces inside a line, as in letter signatures and section-break asterisks, kept); indented letters stay paragraphs. Adventure numbers and story titles are level-2 headings and numbered sections level-3 headings, under the book title.
